verdict.rationale: Honcho's own GitHub repo lists official Python and TypeScript SDKs for adding memory to a product. The docs reference SDK-style methods (`context()`, `.chat()`) and SDKs sharing the CLI config file, and they separate these from integrations in unsupported languages. missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation (installation, versioning, full method coverage) in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
